videos.title: OpenClaw is Insane. Here's the Safe Way to Use It #ad
videos.description:
Head to hostinger.com/ocaliabdaal and use code 'OCALIABDAAL' to get 10% off #ad

I've been using a life changing AI assistant called OpenClaw. It's basically like ChatGPT or Claude but way more powerful.

You probably don't want to install something this powerful on your own computer because it has access to all your files and could destroy everything. Which is why I'd recommend installing it on a VPS (virtual private server) instead. That way if your AI agent goes rogue, it deletes files on a $5/month server rather than your own computer.

As you get more comfortable you can carefully give it small amounts of access like read-only access to your calendar or workspace.

Hostinger makes this super easy. With one click you can spin up your own VPS with OpenClaw installed straight out of the box. Everything stays under your control:

💾 Your data
🗨️ Your chat logs
🤖 Your AI automations
